scope: Browser layout and motion demo only; no native keyboard, mobile runtime, Agent, audio or business integration.
checks: 90 combinations: 3 screen sizes × 3 body-font scales × 10 states. Header, content and the single glass tray keep their own non-overlapping areas; the tray is never clipped by the device edge; smallest content box is 192px in chat-keyboard at 320×640; while typing the reply being answered stays on the paper and the window keeps at least 150px.
Draft is preserved when opening a note and returning to the same conversation.
Long note reaches its last paragraph; before/after edit panes are actually switchable.
Submit adds the message to the local thread, shows a thinking state, then a reply that scrolls into view.
Tab switches travel sideways in the direction of the move; the outgoing and incoming pages are never both legible on the same pixels.
A measured A/B on the same page: if off-stage screens only faded to zero opacity they would still composite 30 backdrop-filter layers, against 15 as shipped.

Header shrink, keyboard, tab pill and screen push were sampled per frame. The pill is driven by one spring per edge so it stretches to 175px mid-travel and settles at 121px; scrolling collapses the header the same way the keyboard does.
Each panel enters from its own control: left drawer for the menu, growing out of the companion and the space pill for those, bottom only for 递材料.
Task stop changes the displayed local task state without removing already available material.
No-blur fallback removes the blur from the tray and the cards while keeping the same layout.
No page runtime errors during interaction and captures.
